Body.Content:
This update provides information about recent updates to Site Recovery components.

  • Site Recovery Unified Setup and Site Recovery Mobility agent for Windows/CentOS/Ubuntu machines (9.28.5345.1)—Used for replication of VMware virtual machines (VMs) and physical servers to Azure.
  • Site Recovery configuration server (5.1.4800.0)—Used for replication of VMware VMs and physical servers to Azure.
  • Site Recovery provider (5.1.4800.0)—Used for Hyper-V VM replication to Azure.
  • Azure Recovery Services agent (2.0.9165.0)—Used for replication of Hyper-V VMs to Azure.

For more information, read Microsoft support article 4521530.
